$comment: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE. Shaped like a response from the current ACLED API at https://acleddata.com/api/acled/read, so the parser can be exercised offline. The events are invented and no real incident is described. Country and place names are real only so that the country-code lookup and the pipeline's location handling are exercised. Field names, and the status/success/count/data envelope, follow ACLED's published column list for the acled endpoint; the retired api.acleddata.com platform's iso3 and data_id fields are absent because the current schema does not return them.

data.notes: An invented peaceful demonstration recorded for fixture purposes.
A fictional armed clash used to exercise the fatality-to-severity mapping.
A fictional record whose latitude is unusable, so it must arrive without coordinates.
A record with no identifier at all, which the parser must skip rather than guess at.
